design: CONTACT-POINT PLAUSIBILITY: paddle center only trusted when within reach of the dominant wrist — reach = 1.2 × arm-length (arm = median |shoulder→elbow|+|elbow→wrist| of the dominant side over ±300ms at vis≥0.5, ≥3 frames) else 1.5 × torso. Dev-measured anchors: verified-good tracks sit 0.36-0.41 arm-lengths from the wrist; dev arm/torso 0.72-1.30 so 1.2×arm ≈ 0.9-1.6 torso. Implausible paddle → wrist point + limitingFactor 'paddle_point_implausible_used_wrist'. Paddle unverifiable (wrist invisible) + low track confidence → ABSTAIN 'contact_point_unreliable_paddle_unverified_wrist_invisible'

PROVENANCE: contactPointSource ('paddle'|'wrist') + contactPointReliability ('strong'|'degraded') recorded (ADDITIVE fields). Degraded = paddle obs confidence < 0.3 (dev separation: stale rally2 track 0.08-0.28 vs verified wm-volley track 0.68-0.85) or wrist fallback at vis < 0.5 or plausibility unverifiable

OVERHEAD EVIDENCE: skeletal raise scan over ±150ms of contact (vis≥0.5 frames only): dominant wrist ≥ +0.25 torso above the per-frame shoulder line (≥2 frames) and elbow ≥ +0.10 (≥2 frames); the ±80ms visibility-gated MEDIAN is computed and recorded as evidence but is decision-blind on dev (holds 1 post-contact frame at 30fps: the smash apex sits 81-147ms BEFORE the estimated contact — documented in code). Decision matrix: point-high + window-corroborated → OVERHEAD (conf ≤0.85); point-high + window-unmeasured → OVERHEAD only on strong provenance (conf capped 0.6); point-high + window-quiet → NO overhead claim (degraded → UNKNOWN); point-low-but-degraded + BOTH joints repeatedly raised → OVERHEAD from window evidence (conf ≤0.7, tension recorded as limitingFactor)

ABSTENTION BAND: degraded provenance + side margin < 0.5 shoulder-widths → UNKNOWN with reasons (universal floor 0.15 unchanged; good-provenance dev commitments measure 1.99-2.32); degraded side commitments capped at confidence 0.6

risks: n=2 measurable dev cases for every new constant; held-out transfer unverified by design (no held-out regen/tuning). The corroboration thresholds separate dev cleanly (raised frames 3 vs 0; max raise +0.64 vs −0.24; track conf 0.08-0.28 vs 0.68-0.85) but real margins on unseen cases are unknown

±150ms raise window is wider than the ±80ms the contact estimator is benchmarked to — a neighboring stroke <150ms away could leak raise evidence into a non-overhead contact (no such dev case; events are ≥400ms apart in the corpus)

window-over-degraded-point OVERHEAD (rally2 branch) intentionally lets repeated skeletal evidence beat a low-confidence point; if pose left/right arm identity swaps mid-window at high reported visibility, a raised NON-hitting arm could masquerade as the dominant wrist (dominant-wrist selection is travel-based, which mitigates but does not eliminate this)

abstention band (degraded + margin <0.5) and both-unreliable abstention are unexercised on dev (unit-tested only); their real-world abstention rate is unmeasured — could over-abstain on portrait/occluded captures where paddle confidence runs low
paddle observation confidence is heuristic-v1 (uncalibrated) — the 0.3 floor inherits its instability; if the paddle-confidence model is recalibrated, the floor must be re-derived

strict cascade counts any UNKNOWN as STROKE non-pass: on captures where stroke-heuristic-1 guessed right by luck from a degraded point at margin <0.5, stroke-heuristic-2 abstains — strict survival can drop while usable-result-v1 honesty improves (no such dev case; stated so the tradeoff is on the record)
